utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time do you want to start the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Maybe around 10, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 10 works for me. I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the logistics—do we know who’s bringing the tools and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm who’s handling the tools and the meeting spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check on that, but I don’t have it confirmed yet. I’d feel better once we know both the tools and the meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might've missed the latest details, what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, sorry, I’m a bit fuzzy on the latest too. I know we’re collecting repair items, but I should check the details and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries — let’s check the list when you get a chance, and I can help spread the word once we know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell the others about the repair drive and make sure the plan gets around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll pass it along and make sure everyone hears about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m a little late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we just need a couple more hands on the tool table and someone to help sort the donated parts. If you’ve got a minute, you can jump right in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m on it — I’ll help at the tool table and sort parts too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what time are we meeting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re meeting at 9:00 Saturday morning by the community shed, and please bring work gloves if you have them. If you can, also grab a hammer or screwdriver to share.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll be there at 9:00 Saturday by the community shed with gloves, and I’ll bring a hammer if I can find one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam — are we still on for the repair drive this week?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive this week. Just let me know the time and what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll send the time and a short list of supplies today.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive—want me to help spread the word to both groups?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please do—let both groups know the repair drive starts at the community center and runs through Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll tell both groups it starts at the community center and runs through Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the next task you want me on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you take point on the supply list and check what tools we still need? If you can, also note anyone who’s offered to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll take point on the supply list, check which tools we still need, and note who’s offered to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what we still need for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s already been gathered, and I’ll note the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got a box of donated screws, some paint, and a couple of hammers so far. I’ll let you know if anything else turns up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve noted screws, paint, and hammers. Just send me the next items as they come in, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up this week—folks are already dropping off tools and supplies. If you want, I can keep an ear out for the schedule details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that—please let me know when the schedule’s set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Rey — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t checked the repair drive details yet—what’s the plan, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still sorting the plan, but I can send you the details and what needs doing once I check it. If you can help with timing around school drop-off, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works — send me the details when you have them, and I’ll check the school drop-off timing before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly tools and any spare parts folks can part with—if you’ve got either, I can swing by and pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got a few old tools you can have. Swing by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still aiming for Saturday morning, and I’ll check with the others about tools and the truck.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll let the others know and keep Saturday morning open.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll follow up with everyone about the tools and truck, and I’ll confirm Saturday morning as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest details; what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not much changed, really—just still trying to get the word out and see who can help. I’m keeping it simple and taking it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—I can spread the word if that helps. Just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m in. Just tell me where you need me and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — swing by my place at 9 and bring a screwdriver set and work gloves. I’ve got the rest of the tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll be there at 9 with the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving, Opal. I can help organize the list and keep everyone posted on what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep track of who needs what and where each item should go. Once you’ve got the list, send it my way and I’ll help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll sort the list and send it over shortly. Thanks for helping keep everything organized, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to make sure the timing, supplies, and drop-off plan are all clear first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll pin down the timing, make sure the supplies are set, and confirm the drop-off plan. I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — once you have the details, send them over and I’ll check the schedule and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening — I’m just checking the details before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so we’re still on for it, yes?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in favor of a clear plan for the repair drive. Tell me the time and place, and I’ll keep to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll be there late, but I’ll come by once you’ve got the time and place set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Just send me the time and place when they’re set, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still gathering supplies, and it’s coming along little by little. If you hear of any spare tools or hardware, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear about spare tools or hardware.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m still happy to help; just remind me what time and what I’m supposed to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — we’re meeting at 10 by the community shed, and if you can bring a screwdriver set and work gloves, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — 10 by the community shed, screwdriver set, and work gloves. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the repair drive work around school pickup, if we keep the timing tight. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works for me—how about 3:30? I can be there right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:30 sounds good to me—I can meet you there right after pickup. I’ll keep it brief so we stay on schedule.
